inputs.text: The APC should take the 2027 warning as a call for discipline and responsible leadership, not as an excuse to demonize wealth or turn politics into class resentment. Private enterprise and national service are not enemies; what matters is whether leaders use their authority to strengthen families, uphold order and serve Nigeria as a whole. A party earns trust through steady stewardship and a clear sense of duty—not by chasing every accusation or surrendering to those who would weaken the institutions that hold the country together.

output.main_topic: The APC should respond to the 2027 warning with disciplined, responsible leadership and stewardship.
